discovery_basis.key_finding: Government GIS (USGS/NLCD) provides direct, independently attributable physical-environment evidence that is stronger than the assumed FortyGuard satellite segmentation role for vegetation, impervious surface, and land cover analysis.

proposed_evolution.description: Introduce government GIS as primary physical-environment evidence source; reassign FortyGuard satellite segmentation to optional corroboration role.
proposed_evolution.rationale: USGS/NLCD provides 30m resolution tree canopy cover, fractional impervious surface, and land cover classification — direct physical-environment evidence with federal authority. This is more directly attributable than requiring FortyGuard satellite segmentation to perform that role.

changes.data: Tree canopy, impervious surface, land cover, building footprints
Daily/historical temperatures, climatological records, heat events
Heat event reporting, cooling centers, municipal response

authority_classification: contract_candidate — provider reallocation changes implementation details but does not alter architectural meaning
recommended_disposition: Authorize provider reallocation as implementation evolution, not architectural redesign. The central abstraction (evidence-first, provider-independent) is strengthened, not weakened, by this change.
